messages:
sam_ops: Heads-up — scheduling prod deploy 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC. Rolling canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Plan: 10m observation windows, automatic rollback threshold 5% error or 2x latency.

maya_k: I'm on smoke owner for this window. I'll run quick health probes and prompt-set QA.

li_wei: I'll own rollback if needed. I have the rollback snapshot ready: release-2026-03-20-v1.9. Command:
```
deployctl rollback --to release-2026-03-20-v1.9 --env prod
```

julie_r: Code reviews complete, infra changes are gated behind feature-flag 'routable_v3'. No DB migrations.

noah_p: Can someone confirm quota for dedicated pool? We need to ensure weight-based routing has 2x capacity for canary.

sam_ops: Confirmed — quota bump approved, cluster autoscaler set to 3->6. Also will throttle traffic if mem > 70%.

maya_k: Smoke checklist (quick):
- prefix cache warm ✅
- 0.5s p95 latency on sample prompts ✅
- embeddings sanity (cos sim > .85) ✅

julie_r: small PR to feature-flag release is live: PR #4521 merged.

noah_p: I'll be on standby for queries during canary window. ping me with @noah_p.

ops-bot: Deploy job started in staging at 2026-03-20T21:00:03Z (staging-smoke passed)

sam_ops: Start time 22:00 UTC. Canary 1 -> wait 10m -> verify metrics -> canary 2 -> wait 10m -> full roll.

maya_k: Quick eval note: prompt-set 'billing_edge_case' failed on one vector at canary1. I'll paste logs if it recurs.

li_wei: If that fails again on canary2, i'll trigger rollback. Otherwise proceed.

julie_r: Approvals: @cto_ops (prod signoff) gave verbal OK in yesterday's sync. Adding explicit emoji: :thumbsup: 

maya_k: Approving now — :white_check_mark: 

noah_p: Approving — :thumbsup: 

sam_ops: tagging release captains: @julie_r @li_wei @maya_k — if no objections we'll commence at 22:00 UTC.

julie_r: No objections from infra side.

li_wei: Ready.

ops-bot: deploy-prod job queued (job id prod-20260320-2215)

sam_ops: final note — rollback owner li_wei, smoke owner maya_k, traffic monitor noah_p. Post-rollout survey in #eng-releases 30m after full roll.

maya_k: I'll post smoke results and token-level costs after canary2.

noah_p: I'll watch latency dashboards and alert channel.

sam_ops: Thanks all. Proceeding on schedule unless any last-minute holds.
